correctness.rationale: The first-priority recurrence is exact, independently checked against permutation enumeration for six graph pairs. Finite rational signs are computed for all n<=29 in scope. A monotone-path coupling plus at most eight self-avoiding paths per root and length gives |Delta_n-Delta_29|<=17/1120 for all n>=29. Exact 29-vertex rational values have magnitudes beyond that bound. The proof establishes all quantifiers, not by extrapolating a finite table.
